why: Keep the out-of-core path loadable while breaking what makes it equal the whole-file path: lookups that miss are not reported, inverse edges are keyed by the wrong id, range reads never merge across a gap, a batch is not run again after a miss, the arena is not dropped at its budget, the pool ignores a file the scan names unsupported and the options an arena cannot serve, arena peaks are summed, and a negative budget is accepted. The arena, planner, session, pool and flag tests must go red.
